role: exploratory findability red-team personas; synthetic discovery aids, never benchmark ground truth
rules: Do not infer behaviour from protected or demographic traits.
Vary language, occupational self-knowledge, labour-market history, search strategy and digital/search literacy instead.
Freeze each journey's goal and first query before inspecting selector output.
A persona observation becomes a product finding only after independent verification against source truth, observed query data, product code or human feedback.
Ambiguous journeys may legitimately end in abstention or a request for clarification.
